type: pentode, sharp cut-off ("short characteristic"), dual control (g1 and g3)
source: Owner-supplied scans, no URL. Page 1: handbook page 6Ж2Б (Рис. 214-216; literature cited: Анисимов В., Миниатюрные радиолампы, «Радио», 1954, № 3), GIF 922x790, copy doc/data/6zh2b_sheet_p1.gif. Page 2: label sheet «Лампа 6Ж2Б-В», частные технические условия 3.300.020 ТУ1, Зак. 1685-81, GIF 700x2094, copy doc/data/6zh2b_sheet_p2.gif.
description: High-frequency pentode with a short (sharp cut-off) characteristic, intended for pulse-forming circuits; used in pulse circuits and VHF equipment. Indirectly heated oxide cathode. Works in any position. Miniature glass bulb. Service life at least 500 h. Wire lead base, 7 leads, flexible; lead length at least 35 mm, lead diameter 0.4 mm, untinned part of a lead at most 5 mm from the bulb.

ratings.name: Ukh
ratings.note: DC voltage between cathode and heater

pinout_note: Рис. 214 б: view on the base from the lead side, the 7 leads in one row numbered 1-7, colour mark (ЦМ) at the pin-1 end. Matches the KiCad symbol vacuum_tube:6Ж2Б (1 A, 2 G3, 3 G, 4/5 F1, 6 K, 7 G1). The 6Ж2Б-В sheet numbers its leads differently, see variant_6Zh2B_V.

dimensions.name: untinned part of a lead from the bulb

ia_ua.title: Ia = f(Ua)
ia_ua.method: band on the deskewed crop upscaled 3x (solid: minlen 6, dashed: minlen 5, skip 0), then the median of the points in 2 V bins; curve ends are the ends of the drawn lines
ia_ua.accuracy: +-0.5 V, +-0.05 mA (one line width of the scan, 21 px per mA)
ia_ua.note: The curves are averaged characteristics. Ug1 = -4 V (Ia) and Ug1 = -3 V (Ic2, dashed) run as one line from Ua ~ 55 V to 190 V at ~1.07-1.09 mA; both curves carry the points of that merged line there. Ug1 = -3 V touches the dashed Ug1 = -2 V Ic2 curve at Ua ~ 100-130 V (2.78-2.83 mA).

ic2_ua.title: Ig2 = f(Ua)
ic2_ua.method: band on the deskewed crop upscaled 3x (solid: minlen 6, dashed: minlen 5, skip 0), then the median of the points in 2 V bins; curve ends are the ends of the drawn lines
ic2_ua.accuracy: +-0.5 V, +-0.05 mA (one line width of the scan, 21 px per mA)
ic2_ua.note: See ia_ua for the merged line at ~1.08 mA (Ug1 = -3 V here, -4 V there).

ia_ug3.title: Ia = f(Ug3)
ia_ug3.method: band on the deskewed crop upscaled 3x (minlen 5-6, skip 2) plus a second pass with skip 0 and minlen 8 for curves lying on grid lines, then the median of the points in 0.2 V bins; gaps are dash gaps
ia_ug3.hand_read: (-10, 0) for all three curves: the lines run together from -10 V to about -8 V and end at the plot corner; nothing is given in between. Ug1 = -1 V at Ug3 = 7.4-8.2 V: the curve lies on the 11 mA grid line, value = 11.0 mA +-0.03.
ia_ug3.accuracy: +-0.05 V, +-0.05 mA (one line width of the scan, 21 px per V and per mA)

ic2_ug3.title: Ig2 = f(Ug3)
ic2_ug3.method: band on the deskewed crop upscaled 3x (minlen 5-6, skip 2) plus a second pass with skip 0 and minlen 8 for curves lying on grid lines, then the median of the points in 0.2 V bins; gaps are dash gaps
ic2_ug3.hand_read: Ug1 = -3 V at Ug3 = 0.3 and 0.7 V: the curve lies on the 1 mA grid line, value = 1.0 mA +-0.03.
ic2_ug3.accuracy: +-0.05 V, +-0.05 mA (one line width of the scan, 21 px per V and per mA)

checks.name: self-bias point at Ua = Ug2 = 120 V, Rk = 200 Ohm (Ug1 = -(Ia+Ig2)*Rk, Рис. 215 at 120 V)
checks.result: Ug1 = -1.85 V, Ia = 6.0 mA (table 5.5 +- 2), Ig2 = 3.2 mA (table <= 6)

checks.name: S at the self-bias point (quadratic through Ug1 = -1, -2, -3 V at Ua = 120 V)
two figures agree: Рис. 216 at Ug3 = 0 vs Рис. 215 at Ua = 120 V
monotonic: Ia rises with Ua and Ug3, Ig2 falls with Ua and Ug3, both rise with Ug1
checks.result: largest reversal 0.055 mA, about one line width

checks.name: ratings vs curves
checks.result: no Pa max line on the sheet. The drawn curves pass the ratings: Ua*Ia up to 2.3 W (Pa max 0.9 W), 120 V*Ig2 up to 1.5 W (Pg2 max 0.6 W), Ia+Ig2 up to ~22 mA (Ik max 14 mA), Ua up to 190 V (Ua max 150 V)

variant_6Zh2B_V.source: page 2, частные технические условия 3.300.020 ТУ1, Зак. 1685-81
variant_6Zh2B_V.description: Subminiature high-frequency pentode with dual control, glass bulb with flexible leads, indirectly heated cathode, intended mainly for pulse-forming circuits in radio equipment. Gold content 2.969 g per 1000 tubes (theoretical norm).
variant_6Zh2B_V.pinout_note: 8 positions on a circle; counted clockwise from the cut-off or missing lead (8). The sheet does not say from which side the drawing is viewed. This is NOT the numbering of the handbook page.

dimensions.name: do not bend leads closer than
dimensions.note: from the glass of the stem

notes: Page 1 and page 2 differ: Pg2 max 0.6 W vs 0.7 W, Ukh max 100 V (DC) vs ±150 V, lead length >= 35 mm vs >= 40 mm, Ig2 <= 6 vs <= 5.5 mA, and the lead numbering. The scans are skewed (grid lines tilt by up to 4.4 px across Рис. 215); the crops were sheared straight with `digitize.py deskew` before calibration. Overlays: doc/data/6zh2b_ia_ic2_ua_overlay.png and 6zh2b_ia_ic2_ug3_overlay.png, drawn on the deskewed 3x crop.
